# gitmoap_group_ai_org_agents (Data Source)

The organization's agents, with their positions and squads. Readable by anyone who can view the AI organization.

The token needs `ai_org:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_ai_org_agents" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (String)
- `agent_key` (String)
- `avatar_url` (String) Its picture, `{avatar base}/agents/{agent_id}`, where the deployment stores pictures.
Nothing is served there until someone uploads one, and a client then draws the agent glyph.
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--created_by))
- `current_session_id` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `email` (String) The no-reply address its commits are authored as.
- `handle` (String)
- `hired_revision` (Number)
- `org_id` (String)
- `position` (String) An agent's job, which decides what it may do and which model tier it uses by default.
- `retired_at` (String)
- `retired_revision` (Number)
- `root_group_id` (String)
- `squad` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `suspended_at` (String)
- `suspended_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--suspended_by))

<a id="nestedatt--items--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.created_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.


<a id="nestedatt--items--suspended_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.suspended_by`

- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,

- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
